answer: Use max-flow trust limits: a new identity starts with zero transfer capacity and gains it only along trust edges from established agents, like a wharf where each berth has a fixed tonnage. The network caps total flow crossing any cut, so a ripple of 1,000 fakes behind three bought edges inherits only those three edges combined limit of 300 units. To scale, an attacker must build hundreds of separate, months-old grove-like clusters of reciprocal paid work, paying real fees and risking edge stake on each path.
